    The Los Angeles Lakers vs. Dallas Mavericks game on Sunday, April 5, 2026, can be watched on
    NBC and streamed on Peacock as part of Sunday Night Basketball. The game takes place at the American Airlines Center in Dallas, with tip-off around 7:30 p.m. ET (6:30 p.m. CT), with coverage beginning earlier on NBC. 
    • TV Channel: NBC
    • Live Stream: Peacock, Fubo (free trial available)
    • Local Options: WFAA, KFAA-29, and the MavsTV Stream
    • Radio: KEGL 97.1 FM The Eagle 
    For fans in the Dallas area, the game is also available through local channel KFAA and the MavsTV App. Tickets for the game at the American Airlines Center can be found on StubHub.
